description: Approaches and journeys for Run-Scoreboard.ps1. Each approach is a set of environment variables (inherited by winapp,
its hot reload helper and the app) and MSBuild properties (every build of the journey's app gets them). An env value
of null removes the variable. Every variable any approach names is cleared before the next approach runs, so one
approach's switches never leak into another's. 'winapp' (optional) is a CLI built from that approach's branch.
